info.name: Amplify Platform API v1.0.0 aca domain API

items.docs:
Create and send IdP domain association verification email.

___Auth Requirement___
 - _All of_
     - `administrator` access to the organization.
     - The organization entitlements allow `idp`.
     - Disallow action for internal organization.


_Allows consumer organization access_

info.name: Axway Associate Subdomain to Parent Domain IdP

items.docs:
Attempt to confirm the association of a subdomain to a parent domain's IdP.

___Auth Requirement___
 - _All of_
     - `administrator` access to the organization.
     - The organization entitlements allow `idp`.
     - Disallow action for internal organization.


_Allows consumer organization access_

info.name: Axway Enable IdP for a Domain

items.docs:
Enable the association of an Identity Provider for all users on a supplied domain.

___Auth Requirement___
 - _All of_
     - `administrator` access to the organization.
     - The organization entitlements allow `idp`.
     - Disallow action for internal organization.


_Allows consumer organization access_
